question.text: 'Saraswati Cat III Open-Ended AIF' has a committed corpus of INR 500 crore. Sponsor commitment is 5% of corpus with a statutory cap. What is the sponsor's contribution?

answer.text: INR 10 crore (lower of 5% of INR 500 cr = INR 25 cr, or INR 10 crore)

explanation.text: The Logic: The Cat III sponsor/manager continuing interest rule is the LOWER of 5% of corpus or INR 10 crore. 5% of INR 500 cr = INR 25 cr; INR 10 cr is lower, so the sponsor contributes INR 10 crore. The Trap: Option B ignores the INR 10 cr cap. Option C applies an incorrect percentage. Option D applies the Cat I/II rule (lower of 2.5% / INR 5 crore), not the Cat III rule. Note: Once corpus exceeds INR 200 crore, Cat III sponsor commitment plateaus at the INR 10 crore cap regardless of further corpus growth.
